gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-quattrocento-sans: Quattrocento Sans keeps its gaps tidy enough that c never slides into o, a plain sans with a modern, scrubbed look. Cherry Swash sits above it, loud and uniform in line.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-red-hat-text: Approachable curves give Red Hat Text a loose, unclamped feel, drawn with the thin line of a technical pen. Cherry Swash hangs above in heavy, distinctive display letters, so give the sans a comfortable size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-reddit-sans: Commanding horseshoe curves and chunky diagonals make Cherry Swash hard to miss at the top. Reddit Sans then settles in below with a wide-mouthed e and a steady line, easy going across many paragraphs.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-rethink-sans: That wide horseshoe c is the first thing Cherry Swash shows you, with diagonals as heavy as its verticals. But Rethink Sans is the one built for sustained reading, its openings staying generous at every weight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-roboto-flex: Roboto Flex reads modern and welcoming, with a wide slot between the two ends of its c, which keeps each word easy to scan. Cherry Swash adds the loud, squeezed-line headline above it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-rosario: Cherry Swash cuts every letter like sign-shop vinyl, one line width throughout. Rosario's c ends never curl inward, so the sans reads open and contemporary, and a modest body size lets it stay that way.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ruluko: Lines that hold their thickness from end to end give Cherry Swash its blunt, distinctive presence. And Ruluko, a plain sans with broad counters on c and s, looks best at a generous size beneath it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sansation: Sansation reads approachable and smooth, with no ink pooling where its curves turn inward. Cherry Swash does the shouting, no hairlines and no swells anywhere, while Sansation does the quiet, steady work of carrying text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sarabun: Chunky, horseshoe-curved and impossible to ignore, Cherry Swash drops its curves onto stems with no swelling at all. And Sarabun, a plain sans with a wide channel into every bowl, is the easygoing counterweight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-sarala: Sarala has distinct gaps in c, e and s, and a stroke like neon glass tubing, which makes it feel approachable and contemporary. But Cherry Swash brings a commanding, heavy-diagonal punch, and the two feel pleasantly mismatched.
